detail.longDescription: We're a few years into the latest AI boom, and things have matured a bit. It turns out AI is better at writing code than English, so it's computer engineers and not journalists who've had to radically rethink how they work. Still, AI writing generators are popular, widely available, and worth talking about. A few things to acknowledge before we get started.
